description: Estimate economic compensation (经济补偿金) when employment ends in mainland China: N, N+1 or 2N under the Labour Contract Law, with the high-earner cap, the part-year rule and the questions that decide which case applies. Use when asked 我被裁员了能拿多少补偿, N+1 怎么算, 经济补偿金计算, 违法解除 2N, or how much severance am I owed in China. Not legal advice.
